sources.title: GitHub - Google-Health/medgemma
sources.snippet: MedGemma is a collection of Gemma 3 variants that are trained for performance on medical text and image comprehension. Developers can use MedGemma to accelerate building healthcare-based AI applications.

sources.title: MedGemma — Google DeepMind
sources.snippet: Accelerate the development of healthcare-based AI applications MedGemma 1.5 4B enables developers to more effectively adapt MedGemma for applications that involve high-dimensional imaging (CT, MRI, and whole slide histopathology), longitudinal analysis of chest X-rays, anatomical localization, and other medical imaging and text functionality.

sources.title: MedGemma Technical Report - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: MedGemma demonstrates advanced medical understanding and reasoning on images and text, significantly exceeding the performance of similar-sized generative models and approaching the performance of task-specific models, while maintaining the general capabilities of the Gemma 3 base models.
